newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil launches cell phone Band B tenders.
newsitem.headline: Brazil launches cell phone Band B tenders.

text.p: Brazil Thursday began the formal bidding process for cellular telephone Band B concessions, the Communications Ministry said.
The ministry said in a statement that a public hearing would take place December 5 and that 15 days later, the tender details will be available to interested parties.
The ministry said that in mid-January, it intended to hold a meeting with bidders to discuss networking arrangements, "the technical details essential for the formulation of bids".
It said no timetable had been set for the government to announce a formal decision but that the wish of the ministry was to announce winners by the end of May.
According to a decree published in Thursday's Official Journal, 10 service areas are up for grabs:
-- Rio de Janeiro and Espirito Santo states
-- The state of Rio Grande do Sul
-- The states of Goias, Tocantins, Mato Grosso do Sul, Rondonia, Acre and the Federal District
-- The states of Amazonas, Roraima, Amapa, Para and Maranhao
-- The states of Piaui, Ceara, Rio Grande do Norte, Paraiba, Pernambuco and Alagoas
